mission.title: Those Less Fortunate
mission.description: Find a safe meeting place for the Merovingian's talks with Zion.

npc.say:
Of course, I was coming to exactly the same conclusion.
I don't know what you're waiting around here for, {player}.

Now you get perhaps a glimpse of why it is that I have outlasted so many others, so many instances of this simulation, non? Others inevitably seek to remove you from power, but you never take it personally. A la fin, it is all business.
Wait them out, bide your time, until fate brings you the instrument of your salvation.
Remember this, {player}. Those without patience are lost in this world.

phase.briefing:
{player}, you aren't going to believe this. Well, actually you probably will, you believe anything. Zion is asking us for help!
They're coming to us, looking for help saving their poor Niobe, and they actually expect us to--
Well that's odd. The boss himself wants to see... both of us.

enter.say: The Merovingian is on site! Mind your manners...

talk.say:
Ah, good, I was afraid something had happened to you, {player}. We've been waiting for some time, you know.
Now, on to the news. As I was telling you earlier, the foolish Zionists have come to us for help! And they think that we're going to help them! Can you--

We are going to help them, Flood.
I suppose you're delighting in the irony of this situation too much to appreciate what we have to gain, non? And now we know why you aren't in charge.
Obligation. Being in one's debt. Beholden. Bound by one's own conscience. Even if you don't comprehend, Flood, I believe our friend {player} understands what I am proposing. How does that go... "People who wish to be thought of as good are always weak." And none more so than our dear, eager Zionists. We shall place them in our debt -- out of the goodness of our hearts, of course -- and then we shall watch them squirm.
I do believe it's time to prepare a meeting place. Go there and verify its safety, {player}.

phase.briefing: What a relief that the Merovingian took my advice to help the Zionists! This truly is one of my greatest ideas. True, there have been many, but the payoff!

enter.say: This is supposed to be the place, but it looks like we've got some signals in there already.
Looks like we've got some company. Take them out.

done.say: I don't want to deal with any rabble, I talk to you enough as it is. Get out of there, I'll find something else.

phase.briefing: Perhaps this will be more suitable. Check for any riff raff, will you?

enter.say: I'm not reading anything in there, but you might as well take a look to be sure.

talk.say:
Ah, yes, this will do. Just squalid enough to put the cave monkeys at ease.
That's all I'm going to need you for.

done.say:
You think I need you here for the meeting? Ah, how refreshingly simple of you.
No, I won't be needing you. Goodbye.

mission.finish:
Ah, and there are the Zionist signals, right on time like good little boys and girls.
I'll talk with you again, I'm sure. I always do.
